data.title: 红月卡莲 · 霓虹雨巷的特派潜行
data.description: 夜色渐浓的都市细雨中，卡莲身穿黑色修身皮夹克，双手插在口袋里驻足于霓虹招牌下，艳红短发在水光倒影中格外鲜明。
data.action: hands in pockets, standing in light drizzle, sharp watchful gaze
data.lighting: colorful neon reflections glowing on wet pavement and leather
data.promptProse: On a sleek neon-lit Tokyo street glistening with light rain, Kallen Kouzuki walks with hands in her leather jacket pockets, her bright red hair illuminated by neon glow.
data.animaCaption: Kallen walking down a rainy neon street in a leather jacket.
